title: App crashes when trying to login to tidepool
symptom: AAPS crashes when trying to setup the tidepool upload. After updating to AAPS 3.4.0.0, the app crashes when trying to login or upload to tidepool. Pressing login shows 'opening login screen', the app hangs and restarts without showing any login window.
cause: The issue is related to the default browser (vanadium on GrapheneOS) not supporting Custom Tabs for OAuth authentication, causing the crash.
fix: Change the default browser to Chrome, which resolves the issue. Alternatively, adding a queries intent for CustomTabsService to the AndroidManifest.xml was suggested but did not help.
evidence_quote: it's related to android. you may try to change your default browser to chrome
